info.title: No Part Finance Integration API
info.description:
No Part Finance is a self-hosted personal finance application for tracking Cash and Credit Accounts, recording transactions and transfers, and reporting Income and Expenses by Category. Budget provides informational planning, and Simulator projects future account balances without changing the ledger. One Owner manages the shared ledger; an optional Auditor has read-only access.

This integration API lets external agents and programs read financial and planning information, submit proposed ordinary transactions or transfers/payments for Owner review, read and update all current Pending items, and check their own submission status. It cannot directly create ledger transactions, approve proposals, or change application configuration.

Respect entered USD signs: Income ledger=entered; Expense ledger=-entered. Expense refunds and Income reversals use negative entered dollars. Computed response money uses integer cents and dates use ISO calendar dates; editable Pending amount fields retain entered USD strings. Human approval is always required; pending/rejected proposals affect no financial totals. Owner review corrections may be saved while a proposal remains Pending; original content continues to identify agent retries.

/docs and this contract are public and contain only fictional examples; all documented API operations require Bearer authentication. Secrets are recoverable in finance.db; database backups and packages containing the database are credentials, and restoring them restores the saved revocation state. No outbound delivery or vendor-specific compatibility is provided.

Transfers require type=transfer, a positive entered USD amount, distinct eligible active From/To Accounts, explicit Date and Description, and no Category. After approval From is negative and To positive with zero sum. Manual creation and moving existing events to Pending are Owner browser actions, unavailable to Bearer callers; all Pending items, including Manual and moved events, are readable and updateable through the Pending API. Terminal status history remains caller-specific. Each Bearer key is permanently scoped to one ledger; supplied record IDs never broaden access. Disabled or permanently revoked keys cannot authenticate. Owners can re-enable Disabled keys, but cannot re-enable Revoked keys. No ledger selector parameter is supported.

integrationBearer.description: Owner-created active integration secret, supplied only in Authorization header. No browser login, direct ledger/configuration writes, or approval/rejection privileges. Submissions persist proposals for Owner review.

post.summary: Submit one transaction or transfer for Owner approval
post.description: Only Pending state is written. Ordinary requests retain their exact original fields. Transfer requests require exactly submissionId, type: transfer, date, fromAccountId, toAccountId, description, amount. Reject mixed or unsupported fields. Date is explicit; no inferred today. Accounts must be distinct, active and transfer-eligible; External may be either side, and Credit/Loan destinations remain payments through this same operation. Positive entered amount becomes negative From and positive To ledger cents only on Owner approval, never Income/Expenses. No balance-based restrictions or payoff defaults. Original submitted type/content remains immutable for retries through saved corrections, decisions and restart. Identical ID/content returns current status; differing content/type conflicts. No bulk, reimbursements or direct writes. Owner-only Manual entries and moves share review, Bearer cannot create Manual items or move/decide events, and may read and update all current Pending items through the Pending operations. When integrationTransferDefaultDescription is enabled, transfer descriptions are replaced with the destination default in saved Pending review content. Original submitted content remains the retry identity; Owner approval is still required.

get.description: Lists only the authenticated integration’s submissions. Optional submissionId and status filters, existing pagination. Identifiers and kind describe the current decision. Ordinary Approved transactionId may become null after deletion; Approved transferId is retained after deletion though a ledger lookup may find no rows. Retries never recreate deleted events. Owner and API corrections remain separate from original retry type/content. Manual entries and moved ledger events are not listed by this caller-specific status operation; use /api/integration/pending for all current Pending sources. reviewVersion is included; successful Owner or API saves advance it.

get.summary: Read all current Pending transactions and transfers
get.description: Complete unpaginated read-only snapshot of every Pending source: any integration, Manual Save as Pending, and events moved from the ledger. Includes latest Owner/API corrections, current reviewVersion, original/current Reporting Roles and validation flags. No query parameters. Contains no terminal history, integration secrets, credentials, immutable original payloads or private source snapshots. Each transfer counts once. An empty queue has zero counts and rows: []. No database or planning mutation.

put.summary: Update any Pending transaction or transfer
put.description: Replace one Pending item's complete editable fields, regardless of submitting integration or Manual/moved source and even after Owner edits. Send the id from GET /api/integration/pending in the path, with that row's current reviewVersion. Ordinary updates include reviewedRole from the selected Category's current reportingRole; transfer updates omit it. Do not send kind, type, id, submissionId, pin, source, status or attribution fields. Python reuses Owner save validation and a single SQLite transaction. When integrationTransferDefaultDescription is enabled in Settings, transfer POST submissions and PUT updates use the destination default description in saved Pending review content; immutable original POST retry content is preserved. Ordinary descriptions and Owner edits remain unchanged. Every successful save, including unchanged content, advances reviewVersion. Stale retries fail with 409: read /api/integration/pending and reconcile; never automatically replace the expected version. Only review content/version changes. The item stays Pending, financial values and Simulator links do not change, original retry content/source snapshots/pin remain intact, and Owner approval/rejection remains required. No delete, approval/rejection, partial/bulk update, or direct ledger operation.
